issues: Printed CXLIX runs from middle PDF660/printed626 to original PDF668/printed634 before an entirely separate substantive UNNUMBERED eleventh-house intro Of Friends, not a continuation of profession.

The chapter repeatedly names Mercury, Venus and Mars as possible or joint profession significators, but other planets, zodiac sign, house, relative strength and overriding partile aspects may completely change the claimed profession; no fixed priority score for all contradictory combinations is supplied.

An occupation label, interest, income, lifelong main activity, performance quality, social esteem and family role are separate outcomes. Professional success/fame subsection must not be counted as correct career type in any future evaluation.

Most of the old occupational lists allow many jobs under a single configuration, often spanning scholarly disciplines, commerce, warfare, cooking, farm work and even clergy, thereby providing very low post-hoc discriminative specificity.

Several source claims stigmatize poorer classes and assert thieves, murderers, poisoning, lying or sex-work roles from astrological placements. No character, crime, violent risk or protected religious classification about any real person may be inferred from these historical labels.
The text alleges divination, prophetic interests, magical practice and sorcery from sign and planet aspects. It does not establish actual supernatural powers or medical/mental diagnoses.
Cazimi is explicitly an exception to combustion for Mercury-Sun and Venus-Sun in earlier and current material; a single burn/combustion predicate cannot be used blindly.

Mercury-Jupiter may be associated with respected lawful speakers, while Mercury-Saturn or Mercury-Mars variants include both legitimate crafts and unsupported criminal accusations. The author therefore supplies contradictory profession classes under nearby natal predicates.

Venus-Mercury, Mars-Mercury and Venus-Mars compound rules can depend on additional Saturn, Jupiter, Moon, Sun, relative dignity and zodiac sign, and some planetary glyph combinations require independent diplomatic collation.

The original profession success section requires source significator essential dignity, absence of malignant partile contact, angularity and orientality; weak/cadent/occidental variants make pejorative assertions about craft skill and industry.

Source zodiac taxonomy includes movable, fixed EXCEPT Scorpio, humane, water/earth, quadruped; the passage attributes additional elemental jobs to ALBUBATER, whose own original writing remains uncollated.
A previous Lilly general planetary-nature section at printed pages 57–83 is cited but not re-extracted in this specific chapter.

No frozen occupation ontology, measured modern job distributions, birth-time-confirmed real cohort, education/class/location controls, negative prediction denominator or chart calculation implementation used here.

Following printed CHAP CL on quality of friends starts PDF670 AFTER unnumbered eleventh-house friendship introduction PDF668–669. The immediate next canonical source must be unnumbered and add ZERO numbered chapters.
The packet uses reversible short photographed original text anchors and historical paraphrases, not a full diplomatic facsimile transcription. Claims are not validated human forecasts.
